title: Hoshino Ichika — The Vow In My Heart〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Phew!
We're sounding really good together for every song.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. All that's left is for us to get to where we can play without taking any breaks.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've got this! We have way more stamina now thanks to our solo show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, Hona worked so hard that she's super buff now♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, look at my big biceps! Well, not really...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Does this mean you agree with her, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It is true that I'm much stronger now because of our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, I feel more confident now after being able to play the way I wanted until the very end.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you haven't been hesitating at all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, if we can keep this up, our show's gonna be a huge success♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And after it's done, we're gonna go see the Peperoncino... I mean, the Perseid meteor shower together!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. You got it right this time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I didn't hear what you said clearly that time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, we should probably get a few things ready for the meteor shower...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Get things ready?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Remember how we took cushions over when we went stargazing in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I thought it'd be nice to have some things that allow us to lie back as we watch like we did then.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we won't be doing our necks any favors if we have to look up for long periods...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we're gonna go to that park with the jungle gym, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we're gonna be there, I wanna watch from the top of it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The jungle gym...)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: What's the matter, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... Just making a wish that we could stay like this forever!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Playing together, talking about stuff, watching shooting stars on our way home...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I wish we could keep doing all that together forever!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I want to watch from that jungle gym too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, we won't need a tarp or anything.
What else do we need...? Oh, probably some bug spray.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... But isn't that about all we really need?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, hang on!
What about snacks and drinks?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But we're meeting at night.
I'm sure we'll all have eaten dinner already...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, we're really not gonna bring any?! Don't you wanna have a nighttime picnic?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get how you feel, but we might miss some of the shooting stars while we're focused on eating and drinking.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But what if we get hungry...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, fine...
Bring whatever.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
If we happen to be alone, why don't we try inviting Miku and the others?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure.
But they're probably pretty used to seeing pretty skies...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They need to see how pretty our sky can be♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we can ask them when we go over to practice next time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get back to practicing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We need to play the songs between our talk portions like it's the real deal.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Okay!
